text:
Ava: quick design check 11 proposing: make flamegraph nodes keyboard-focusable + show export in node menu. short PR, but we should align a11y behaviors.
Ravi: agree. tab order question 11 timeline scrub vs details panel? i vote scrub after details. users often read details first.
Sam: accessibility: node -> details -> timeline -> export. also ensure focus trap not applied to details when user tabs to timeline.
Marta: checklist: aria-labels on nodes, role=button for node clicks, aria-live for selection changes, announce "Correlation ID copied" (role=status).
Olivia: copy tweak: rename "Export trace" -> "Download trace (.json)" and add "Export spans (.csv)". also add tiny hint on formats.
Ava: CSS for focus ring (high contrast): ```css .flame-node:focus{outline:3px solid #0055aa;outline-offset:2px;} ``` include dark-mode token.
Marta: shortcut ideas: focused node: c = copy corr id, e = open export. need global conflict matrix.
Sam: i'll implement behind flag, add analytics events: trace_export_click, span_csv_export, corrid_copy. preserve focus on dialog close.
deploy-bot: ui-preview/trace-flame-v2 deployed to staging (build 2213).
Ava: i'll update figma with focus order, aria attrs, and microcopy. pls drop final nits in the file. :eyes:
